name: Villa d'Este, Tivoli
description: Villa d'Este is a 16th-century palace in Tivoli, a hill town just outside Rome. Its steep terraced garden is packed with fountains and ornamental basins, which made it one of the first "gardens of wonders" and a model for later European gardens. Today it is a state museum, and wandering its shaded paths among the water displays is the main draw.
